description: Read a UTF-8 text file by a 1-based line range and return its full-file SHA-256 version hash. Paths are workspace-relative unless the user explicitly enabled unrestricted host access.

propertyDescriptions.path: Workspace-relative file path, or an absolute host path only in unrestricted mode.
propertyDescriptions.startLine: The first 1-based line to return. Omit it to begin at the start of the file.
propertyDescriptions.endLine: Final 1-based line. Omit for the configured locating window (default 100 lines). Explicit ranges allow up to 1000 lines by default, subject to the separate read-result token budget. Inspect actual endLine and nextStartLine.

guidance: If location is unknown, use search_files or a small read to locate it, then read a coherent function/class and enough surrounding code in one larger range. Known locations and small files may be read directly; a preliminary read is not mandatory. Avoid many tiny consecutive reads. Output preserves complete lines and a full-file version hash; inspect truncation and nextStartLine. Absolute host paths require Dangerous full access.
